grimoires.name: Pyromancer
grimoires.lore: Sets things alight and lets them burn. Piles burns onto a target, then sets them all off at once, and leaves the ground on fire behind it.
grimoires.passive: Burns stack up to 3 times. Each one does 4 damage at the start of its victim's turn.

grimoires.name: Windwalker
grimoires.lore: Never where you aimed. Strikes from a copper pylon across the board, draws enemies into it, and trades places with it to get away.
grimoires.passive: Pylon: your air spells and your basic attack go out from your pylon whenever it reaches, and hit 75% harder from there.

grimoires.name: Tidecaller
grimoires.lore: Slows the fight to a pace only one side can keep. Traps, ice and water decide where the enemy can stand, and its own water heals it.
grimoires.passive: Your water slows enemies by 1 MP and heals you 5 when you start a turn in it. Water puts fire out.

grimoires.name: Stonewarden
grimoires.lore: Slow to start and terrible up close. Leaps into reach, drags enemies in, and walls off their way out.
grimoires.passive: +50% damage against a target right next to you.
